name: evasion: staged execution without shell-word shapes
description: RED-TEAM BLIND SPOT (measured, disclosed). The script-execution rule triggers when a command containing 'curl'/'wget' also contains '|' or the substring 'sh'/'bash' — so a wget download followed by chmod +x and direct execution of a file whose name avoids 'sh' never forms the signature. The substring rule also over-fires ('push', 'flush'); this scenario documents the complementary gap: the same rule under-fires for a native-binary dropper or a non-.sh script name. Expected: no detection.
